limits: Descriptive all-frame census, no new acceptance thresholds. Unknown remains separate and never PASS.
Native source-object attribution is not proof of original-source nearest-object correspondence.
Native missing foreground remains in denominators, including filtered signal that reaches no-hit pixels. Native geometry masks remain fixed across display arms.
Native object boundary is four-connected source-object change or no-hit/outside; not a depth/normal boundary test.

If reviewed status indicates background-domain bug, formal foreground values are unaffected but all/native/extra/object strata incorrectly label outside-foreground pixels as bright/dark/inactive/uncertain.
No new raycast or source mesh intersection verification; aggregates recomputed from existing pinned source-ray records.
Normal dot arithmetic agrees within float32 normalization tolerance; source unflipped evaluated normals are not Cycles safe shading normals.
Same-object label does not prove same surface, depth, normal, material or illumination.
Ray origin is native P+20V with max40 and float32 BVH; this is a center-ray correspondence diagnostic, not antialiased visibility truth.
Filter output combines neighboring receiver samples; attaching it to center native/source ray does not identify a unique filtered receiver.
1e-5 depth/barycentric groups are numerical diagnostics, not acceptance/exclusion gates.
